results.description:
From bestselling author, GiGi Meier, a college campus biker romance with a smart and confident chemistry student and his first year college professor at Boston University.

She's teaching him about chemistry in and out of the classroom.

A college senior. His chemistry professor. A pink bike. A dangerous attraction neither of them can ignore.

I was just trying to finish my last semester. Get my degree. Move on. Then she blew past me on a hot pink bike, fast as hell, reckless as sin. I had to know who she was. Had to find her. Had to have her.

But when I finally unmask the daredevil rider, it's worse than I could've imagined. It's her. Dr. Isabella Rossi—my chemistry professor. Smart, sharp, completely off-limits. And now? I'm obsessed.

She might be the one teaching, but I'm about to show her a thing or two about breaking the rules.

Full Throttle is the first book in The Bikers of Boston series, a steamy, forbidden, reverse age gap romance featuring a cocky student, his untouchable professor, and a ride neither of them saw coming.
